body: Residual from the V1-1353 lane (PR #950, 2026-10-16, darwin/arm64, go1.27.x, load 31-73). Each passed 3/3 when run alone, except the last, which failed on BASE too and was not isolated. (1) internal/tasks/cli TestTOLV0027_PreflightDeepStatusPastTheGateTimeoutFails: 'the clean filter never ran' (load 31->44.8; passed 3/3 alone at 43.6). (2) internal/tasks/store TestCALV0078 'WaitDelay expired' and TestPSRV0012PinnedSweep 'runner identity unavailable' in partitioned -race runs (load 35->47; each 3/3 alone at 44.8); PinnedSweep relates to V1-1008. (3) tools/corvint-pr-tests TestCloneTrustEncodingAndLifetime failed on both the lane head and BASE 883caa3d2 (load 63->69); not reproduced quietly, so cause (load vs deterministic) is unknown. Umbrella: V1-0849. Suspected, not confirmed.
title: tests (suspected): TOLV0027 preflight, CALV0078 WaitDelay, PSRV0012 pinned sweep fail under load; TestCloneTrustEncodingAndLifetime fails on base 883caa3d2
